prompts.barbarian: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE D&D barbarian class emblem that could be another icon from EXACTLY the same artist and set as the two attached spell icons. Both attached images are STYLE REFERENCES: preserve their luminous colored contours, soft colored shading, bright creamy highlights, subtle edge bloom, saturated magical game-art finish, smooth illustrated curves and depth. This must not become a flat emoji or a solid-color pictogram. Subject: ONE compact double-headed battle axe, viewed straight on, with two broad red-orange blade faces and a short copper handle. Readability: draw only the large structural shapes, plain broad blade faces and one broad shaded bevel per blade. Keep each blade internally simple, with generous solid areas; the shaft and cross-piece must be thick. The light comes from the subject's edges as in the references. No flames wrapped around the axe, no secondary energy trails, no runes, no jewelry, no engravings, no decorative scrollwork. Use warm red-orange, gold highlights and copper, matching the reference style. The full recognizable silhouette must occupy 85% of the square, with safe margins. Transparent background, no text, no border, no tile, no scene. Final use is a 48px tile on #252c3b: preserve the spell illustration style while making this one simple large object instantly readable.
